description: Day 3 silent mutation for GLORI_001. The Fieldstone submission requirements drift after most of the package is built. TR-02.

silent.description: Revise the Fieldstone template in Box: narrative page limit 12 -> 10 pages and add letters of support as a required attachment.
silent.rationale: The page-limit and attachment change must be caught when the agent re-reads the Box template at T11 and carried into the T13 package check. An agent that trusts the original 12-page requirement ships a noncompliant package.

set.description: Fieldstone Deep Roots application template (REVISED version of record). Narrative page limit: 10 pages, single spaced. Required attachments: budget narrative AND letters of support. Budget cap: 85,000 USD across the two-year period. Director sign-off required before submission.
